expect_red: sweep: a joint's kind is DERIVED from what the artifact carries, and both ends of every joint are assigned to a body by measurement

mutations.contract: A joint end rides a body when that body's pose, applied to the end's as-modelled point, reproduces the end's own point. BOTH ends are assigned separately, and ground wins a tie, because a point that never moves is ground's.
mutations.note: The mutation assigns the `a` end only, which is what this shipped as. A joint between ground and a body has a stationary ground-side `a` end, and a body rotating about the origin reproduces the origin -- so on the real P1 run the pitch plate's two joints were read as the BLADE's, and the plate's triad was drawn at the blade's bore.
